title: Velo Client 1.6: A whole new look
summary: All-new glass menus, a new launcher, a new title screen and a new Locker - plus Instant Play, Tier Tagger, a faster HUD and a long list of fixes.

blocks.text: **Velo Client 1.6** gives the whole client a new face. Every menu, the launcher and the title screen now share one glass design: the game stays sharp, only the panels are frosted. Underneath, there is a pile of new features and fixes.

blocks.caption: R-Shift grown into the full menu: category pills, module cards and live previews.

items: **R-Shift is a glass drawer** - and the HUD editor at the same time: drag, scale and click HUD elements right there, slide it away, or grow it into the full menu
**Every Velo window** - Store, Locker, friends, the emote wheel, Redstone Mode - in the same glass look, opening from and returning to R-Shift
**Theme settings**: accent colour, glass darkness, blur and roundness, live in every menu
A new **HUD Style**: Glass, with real blur, for Keystrokes, Mouse Buttons and Server Display too

blocks.caption: The compact drawer: pinned modules, categories and features, the HUD stays visible.
The new pause menu: strong blur only behind its panels, the game around stays clear.

items: **Pause menu in glass** with quick access to Velo menu, Store, Friends and a bug report
**New title screen** with your player, Realms, Mods, Rewind, Store and Discover
**Customize** (Velo+): your own look for the title, pause and loading screens

blocks.caption: The Locker: skin, cloaks, wings, auras, emotes and more - with a live 3D preview and poses.

items: **New Home** with your 3D player, the games that are running, your friends and the news
**Glass pages** everywhere, a new **Theme editor**, and a cleaner Play dock
**Instant Play** (Settings, off by default): the game waits hidden at its title screen, so Play opens it at once
**Game priority boost** for Windows (on by default, can be turned off): faster loading and steadier frames next to other programs
The Linux .deb now carries the full version number

blocks.caption: The Store in the new look.

items: **Tier Tagger**: PvPTiers and SubTiers tiers above heads and in the tab list
**Velo Turbo, Velo Rewind and the account switcher** now also on Minecraft 1.21.11
**Faster HUD** (HUD Canvas) and two Sodium options: Terrain Culling Window and Leaf Culling Depth
**Armor Bar** follows extra hearts and can hide when the server hides the hearts
**Cloud Sync** redesigned, with restore points by day
Cosmetics are **30% cheaper**, with more daily quests and a rewards strip with Claim buttons
**Velo+** gives 3,000 Velo Coins a month
**1,000 Velo Coins welcome gift** for every new account - and everyone who missed it got it paid
Minecraft 1.21.1: the Velo loading screen finishes again
The Doctor knows the inotify limit crash and packs that need a newer Minecraft
Dozens of small visual fixes in the launcher and the menus, many of them from your reports

blocks.text: Thank you to everyone who tested 1.6 and sent reports - the build you are playing is yours too.
